name: Can I fix a leaky faucet myself or do I need a plumber?

mainEntity.name: Can I fix a leaky faucet myself or do I need a plumber?

acceptedAnswer.text: Minor faucet leaks, such as a dripping spout from a compression faucet, can sometimes be fixed by a homeowner with basic tools and replacement parts. However, if the leak is persistent, involves complex faucet types (like disc or cartridge faucets), or you're unsure about the cause, professional help is recommended. Plumbers have specialized tools, parts, and experience to diagnose and repair leaks efficiently, preventing further damage and ensuring a lasting solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Simple leaks may be a DIY fix, but complex or persistent leaks are best handled by a professional plumber to ensure a lasting repair.
